description: Election Commission - The Media Guidelines - Parliament Election 2020 - made by the Election Commission
reasoning: This gazette contains Media Guidelines issued by the Election Commission under Article 104 B(5)(a) of the Constitution. The content specifically addresses electoral processes, including regulations for media coverage during elections, requirements for balanced reporting of political parties and candidates, and procedures for monitoring compliance with election laws. This falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes and related regulatory matters administered by the Election Commission.
